description: This file defines data structures related to container image configuration, including ImageConfig, RootFS, History, and Image, used in container runtime and image management.

classes.name: ImageConfig
classes.description: Defines execution parameters for container images, such as user, environment variables, ports, volumes, and command settings.

classes.name: RootFS
classes.description: Describes the root filesystem layers of a container image, including type and layer digests.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Represents the creation history of image layers, including timestamps, commands, authors, and comments.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents the overall container image metadata, including creation time, author, platform, configuration, filesystem layers, and history.
